digest.component_or_area: LLM runner settings and usage limits extraction
propositions: Extract two pure functions (build_model_settings and build_usage_limits) from runner.py into structured_run.py with explicit parameters including cache_settings, returning (usage_limits, req_limit, eff_max_iter) tuple to preserve non-invertible counter values
Ensure build_model_settings performs no side effects: the _TEMPERATURE_WITHDRAWN_LOGGED mutation remains inline in run() and the extracted function operates as a pure builder
Temperature must be withdrawn when model.supports_temperature is False and retained when True, with per-request limits only capable of raising configured floors never lowering them
Maintain structured_run.py as a leaf module under 500 LOC with no runtime imports from runner.py, verified by test_structured_run_has_no_runtime_import_from_runner
Reduce runner.py to under 700 lines (measured end-state target) by moving the ~80-line region covering model settings, usage limits, and temperature deprecation logic
Add build_model_settings and build_usage_limits to both hardcoded symbol lists in test_structured_run_seam.py to ensure the seam guard asserts coverage of the new extraction
